newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-PLAY STARTS AGAIN AT WIMBLEDON AFTER RAIN DELAY.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-PLAY STARTS AGAIN AT WIMBLEDON AFTER RAIN DELAY.

text.p: Play at the Wimbledon tennis championships was interrupted for nearly three hours on Tuesday.
Heavy rain in mid-afternoon drove players from the courts and it was not until 1740 local (1640GMT) that Boris Becker and Marcelo Rios were able to resume their fourth round match on centre court.
Nearly three days were lost to the weather last week and the forecast remains unsettled.
